name: Rectangle
description: Represents a portion of text or a graphic in a page. Use the Rectangle object and related methods and properties for programmatically defining page layout in a document.
remarks: Use the Item method to return a specific Rectangle object. The following example accesses the first rectangle in the first page of the active document. Use the RectangleType property to determine the type of rectangle. The following example creates a ShapeRange object if the specified rectangle is a shape.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Rectangle object.

properties.name: RectangleType
properties.description: Returns a WdRectangleType constant that represents the type for the specified rectangle.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of pixels from the left edge of the page to the left edge of a rectangle.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of pixels from the top of the page to the top of a rectangle.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long that represents the width, in points, of a rectangle. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the height of a rectangle, in pixels.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the portion of a document that is contained within a rectangle.

properties.name: Lines
properties.description: Returns a Lines collection that represents the lines in a specified portion of text in a page.
